content.expertiseHeading: StaysInMarrakech — Your luxury villa expert in Marrakech
content.expertiseP1: Since 2014, StaysInMarrakech has been supporting discerning travellers and investors in their search for luxury villas in Marrakech. Our in-depth knowledge of the red city and its prestigious neighbourhoods — Palmeraie, Gueliz, Route de l'Ourika, Amelkis, Targa — enables us to offer exceptional properties, carefully selected for their architecture, setting and amenities.
content.statClientsDesc: Over a thousand families and travellers trust us every year for their stays in Marrakech.
content.statVillasDesc: An exclusive selection of villas with private pools, gardens and high-end concierge services.
content.statYearsDesc: A decade of expertise in luxury real estate in Marrakech, at your service.
content.stayTitle: Luxury villa rental in Marrakech — An exceptional stay awaits you
content.stayP1: Marrakech, the red city, fascinates with its palaces, gardens and unique atmosphere. Whether you come for a family holiday, a trip with friends, an exceptional wedding or a business stay, StaysInMarrakech provides luxury villas that will elevate your experience.
content.stayP2: Our villas are located in Marrakech's most sought-after neighbourhoods. The Palmeraie offers a green and peaceful setting just minutes from the city centre. Gueliz, the modern district, combines proximity to shops and tranquillity. The Route de l'Ourika seduces with its Atlas panoramas, while Amelkis and Targa are known for their golf courses and tranquillity.
content.stayP3: Each villa offered by StaysInMarrakech is equipped with heated private pools, landscaped gardens, spacious living areas and high-end amenities. Our concierge team is available 7 days a week to arrange your transfers, restaurant reservations, activities and excursions in the Agafay desert or the Atlas mountains.
content.bookingTitle: How to book your luxury villa in Marrakech?
content.bookingP1: Booking a villa with StaysInMarrakech is simple and secure. Browse our property catalogue, select your stay dates and complete the booking form. Our team will contact you within 24 hours to finalise your booking and answer all your questions. You can also contact us directly by phone at +212 6 21 18 94 96 or by email at contact@staysinmarrakech.com for personalised assistance.
content.bookingP2: Each booking includes a personalised welcome at Marrakech-Menara airport, a private transfer to your villa, and a comprehensive briefing with our on-site team. You also benefit from a dedicated contact person throughout your stay to manage all your requests.
content.conciergeP1: Beyond villa rentals, StaysInMarrakech offers a complete range of services: private chef for gourmet dinners, in-home wellness and spa, quad, buggy and camel riding excursions, luxury car hire and event organisation in exceptional settings. Our goal: to transform your stay in Marrakech into an unforgettable experience.
content.conciergeP2: Our concierge team consists of local professionals who intimately know Marrakech and its surroundings. They take care of everything: reservations at the best restaurants, private tours of the medina, Majorelle and Bahia gardens, or excursions to the Agafay desert. Whether you want a relaxing day by the pool or an adventure in the Atlas mountains, we create a bespoke programme tailored to your wishes.
content.destinationP1: Marrakech is much more than just a tourist destination. It is a city that leaves a lasting impression with its striking contrast between the ancient medina and the modern city of Gueliz, between bustling souks and peaceful riads, between the desert and the snow-capped Atlas mountains. The red city offers a mosaic of cultural, culinary and sporting experiences that will delight all types of travellers.
content.destinationP2: Whether you are passionate about history and architecture, a food lover, a sports enthusiast seeking adventure or simply looking for relaxation and wellness, Marrakech has everything to satisfy you. And with a StaysInMarrakech luxury villa as your base, you will enjoy the best of the city in absolute comfort and elegance.

services.title: Our Services & Activities
services.subtitle: Discover our selection of services and activities in Marrakech

votre-sejour.title: Your stay
votre-sejour.metaDescription: Luxury concierge service in Marrakech. Dedicated concierge, VIP check-in, cleaning, laundry and bespoke services for an unforgettable stay.
votre-sejour.description: Enjoy a luxury stay in Marrakech with our dedicated concierge services. A personal concierge takes care of every detail so you have nothing to do.
votre-sejour.longDescription: Our premium concierge service provides you with a dedicated advisor from your arrival in Marrakech. From airport transfer to organising your activities, every request is handled with meticulous attention. We manage your villa check-in and check-out, coordinate daily cleaning, oversee laundry and ensure your space is always impeccable.
features: VIP check-in and check-out at your villa
highlights: Single point of contact for your entire stay
Available 7 days a week by phone and WhatsApp

vos-repas.title: Your meals
vos-repas.metaDescription: Private catering and luxury dining in Marrakech. Moroccan and international chef, bespoke menus, private dinners in your villa.
vos-repas.description: Our chefs prepare delicious meals tailored to your wishes. Authentic Moroccan cuisine or international gastronomy, directly in your villa.
vos-repas.longDescription: Forget crowded restaurants and enjoy a private dining experience in the comfort of your villa. Our chefs, trained in the finest establishments in Marrakech and internationally, prepare exceptional meals tailored to your tastes, allergies and dietary requirements. From a hearty breakfast to a gourmet dinner under the stars, every meal becomes a moment of sharing.
features: Private dinners on terrace or garden

votre-transport-sur-place.title: Your local transport
votre-transport-sur-place.metaDescription: Luxury car hire with driver in Marrakech. Executive cars, saloons, minibuses, airport shuttles. Private transfers and bespoke travel.
votre-transport-sur-place.description: Travel in complete serenity with our luxury transport services. Executive cars, saloons, minibuses... we have the solution for all your travel needs in Marrakech.
votre-transport-sur-place.longDescription: Whether for a transfer from Marrakech Menara airport, a day excursion in the Atlas or simply getting around the city, our fleet of luxury vehicles and professional drivers guarantee a comfortable and punctual journey. Every vehicle is air-conditioned, spacious and maintained to the highest standards.
features: Day excursions in the Atlas and desert
Vehicle available for the day or week
Mineral water and Wi-Fi in every vehicle

van-avec-chauffeur.title: Minibus with driver
van-avec-chauffeur.metaDescription: Minibus hire with driver in Marrakech. Group, family and corporate transport. Spacious and comfortable minibuses with professional driver.
van-avec-chauffeur.description: Travel comfortably by minibus with driver for your trips in Marrakech and surroundings. Ideal for groups and large families.
van-avec-chauffeur.longDescription: Our minibus with driver service is the ideal solution for groups, large families and corporate seminars. Our 7, 8 and 15-seater minibuses offer generous space for passengers and their luggage. Whether for an airport transfer, an Atlas excursion or a day of discovery in Marrakech, your driver awaits you on time and accompanies you throughout the day.
features: Water, Wi-Fi and USB chargers on board
highlights: Ideal for groups of 4 to 15 people
Driver at your disposal all day

votre-bien-etre.title: Your wellness
votre-bien-etre.metaDescription: Wellness and spa services in Marrakech. Massage, yoga, hammam, sound therapy and body treatments. Relaxation and relaxation in your villa.
votre-bien-etre.description: Treat yourself to moments of absolute relaxation with our wellness services. Yoga, massage, hammam, spa... we elevate your stay.
votre-bien-etre.longDescription: Marrakech is a city of serenity and ancient traditions. Immerse yourself in this unique atmosphere with our exclusive wellness services. Our certified practitioners travel directly to your villa to offer moments of deep relaxation. From relaxing massage to sound therapy, from dawn yoga on your terrace, every treatment is an invitation to let go.
features: Relaxing, Thai, Californian and Balinese massage
Yoga and Pilates session in villa or outdoors

vos-activites.title: Your activities
vos-activites.metaDescription: All activities in Marrakech: quad, buggy, hot air balloon, wakeboard, jet ski, mountain biking, golf. Book your unforgettable experiences.
vos-activites.description: Discover our selection of activities to make your stay unforgettable. Quad, buggy, hot air balloon, wakeboard, jet ski and more.
vos-activites.longDescription: Marrakech offers an exceptional diversity of activities, between the Atlas mountains, the green Palmeraie and peaceful lakes. Our team selects the best experiences for you, guided by passionate professionals. Whether you're seeking thrills or moments of relaxation, we have the perfect activity for every member of your group.
features: Quad and buggy in the Palmeraie and mountains
Wakeboard and jet ski on the lakes
Mountain biking excursions in the Atlas

quad-buggy.title: Quad/Buggy
quad-buggy.metaDescription: Quad and buggy hire in Marrakech. Ride in the Palmeraie and Atlas mountains. Sessions from 1h to 4h with expert guide. All levels.
quad-buggy.description: Looking for thrills? Discover the Palmeraie and mountain trails by quad or buggy with an expert guide.
quad-buggy.longDescription: Explore the sandy tracks of the Palmeraie in Marrakech by quad or buggy. Our team of passionate guides takes you to discover magnificent landscapes, between olive groves, palm groves and Berber villages. The vehicles, regularly maintained and equipped with full protection, are suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced drivers.
features: Photos and videos of the route available
highlights: Routes suitable for beginners and experienced

montgolfiere.title: Hot air balloon in Marrakech
montgolfiere.metaDescription: Hot air balloon flight at sunrise in Marrakech. Flight over the Palmeraie and Atlas. Unforgettable experience with champagne.
montgolfiere.description: Fly over the Palmeraie by hot air balloon and discover Marrakech from a unique angle. An unforgettable experience at sunrise.
montgolfiere.longDescription: The hot air balloon experience in Marrakech is one of the city's most iconic activities. Take off at dawn from the Palmeraie, gentle ascent over palm groves and Berber villages, with the snow-capped peaks of the Atlas as a backdrop. On landing, a traditional Moroccan breakfast with mint tea and fresh orange juice awaits you. A memory etched forever.
features: Flight possible all year round (weather permitting)
highlights: Panoramic views of the Atlas and Palmeraie

wakeboard-marrakech.title: Wakeboard in Marrakech
wakeboard-marrakech.metaDescription: Wakeboard and wake on lake in Marrakech. Wakeboard school for beginners and experienced. Complete equipment and qualified instructor.
wakeboard-marrakech.description: Looking for water thrills? Wakeboard is the perfect activity for water sports enthusiasts on the lakes of Marrakech.
wakeboard-marrakech.longDescription: The lakes of Marrakech, nestled at the foot of the Atlas, offer an ideal setting for wakeboarding. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, our qualified instructors help you progress quickly in complete safety. The cable system allows you to glide at constant speed while enjoying the spectacular mountain scenery.
features: Changing rooms and showers on site
highlights: Exceptional setting at the foot of the Atlas

vtt.title: Mountain biking excursions
vtt.metaDescription: Mountain biking excursions in the Atlas and Palmeraie of Marrakech. Routes for all levels. Electric mountain bike available. Expert guide included.
vtt.description: Explore the trails of the Atlas and Palmeraie by mountain bike. Routes suitable for all levels to discover exceptional landscapes.
vtt.longDescription: Marrakech is an exceptional playground for mountain biking enthusiasts. From the Palmeraie trails to the Atlas passes, our excursions take you to discover varied landscapes: palm groves, gorges, Berber villages and agricultural terraces. Our local guides know every trail and share their passion for the mountains and Amazigh culture with you.
features: Traditional mountain bike and electric mountain bike (e-MTB)
Expert guide trained in first aid
highlights: Departure and return from your villa

terres-d-amanar-polo-berbere-babyfoot-hu.title: Grand Canyon
terres-d-amanar-polo-berbere-babyfoot-hu.metaDescription: Adventure course at the Grand Canyon of Marrakech. Zip line, rope course, Berber polo and team building. Guaranteed thrills for all.
terres-d-amanar-polo-berbere-babyfoot-hu.description: Experience a unique adventure at the Grand Canyon of Marrakech. Zip line, rope course, Berber polo... guaranteed thrills for the whole family.
terres-d-amanar-polo-berbere-babyfoot-hu.longDescription: The Terres d'Amanar complex, located 30 minutes from Marrakech, offers a complete adventure course in the heart of nature. Glide on the 180-metre zip line, tackle the suspension bridges of the rope course, challenge your friends to giant human foosball or try Berber polo. An exceptional playground for families, groups of friends and corporate seminars.
highlights: Exceptional natural setting in the Atlas

golf-1.title: Golf
golf-1.metaDescription: Golf in Marrakech: Greenaouia Palmeraie, Amelkis, Royal Golf. Course booking, lessons with pro and all-inclusive packages.
golf-1.description: Marrakech is a golfer's paradise. Enjoy our prestigious 18-hole courses with spectacular Atlas views.
golf-1.longDescription: Marrakech is home to some of the most beautiful golf courses in North Africa. From the fairways of the Palmeraie to the shaded courses of the Atlas, each course offers an exceptional setting. We book your tee times, arrange transfers and offer sessions with a pro to perfect your swing under the Marrakech sun.
features: Greenaouia Palmeraie, Amelkis, Royal Golf, Noria

desert-sensation.title: Desert thrills
desert-sensation.metaDescription: Desert excursion from Marrakech: buggy, quad, camel and starlit bivouac. 1 to 3 day adventure in the dunes.
desert-sensation.description: Set off on an adventure in the Marrakech desert. Buggy, quad, camel... experience unforgettable moments in the heart of the dunes.
desert-sensation.longDescription: The Marrakech desert, just a few hours from the city, awaits you for a unique adventure. Explore the dunes by buggy or quad, ride a camel at sunset and sleep under the stars in a luxury bivouac. Our desert excursions are designed for all ages and all levels of adrenaline.
features: 2 to 3 day stays in the Sahara (Merzouga)
Buggy, quad and 4x4 in the dunes

visites-decouvertes.title: Discovery tours
visites-decouvertes.metaDescription: Guided tours in Marrakech: Majorelle Garden, Bahia, Koutoubia, souks, Ourika. French-speaking guide, half-day or full-day.
visites-decouvertes.description: Discover the treasures of Marrakech with our guided tours. Majorelle Garden, Bahia, Koutoubia, souks and more.
visites-decouvertes.longDescription: Marrakech is rich in architectural and cultural treasures. Our passionate French-speaking guides take you to discover the must-see sites and hidden gems of the city. From the Majorelle Garden to the bustling souks, through the Bahia Palace and the Koutoubia, every visit is an immersion in Moroccan history and culture.
features: Majorelle Garden + Yves Saint Laurent Museum
Bahia Palace and El Badi Palace
highlights: Photo stops at the best spots

equitation.title: Horse riding
equitation.metaDescription: Horse riding in Marrakech: Palmeraie, Atlas mountains, Essaouira beaches. Riding for beginners and experienced. Ponies for children.
equitation.description: Explore the exceptional landscapes of Marrakech on horseback. Rides in the Palmeraie, mountain treks, gallops on the beach.
equitation.longDescription: Horse riding is a centuries-old tradition in Morocco. Our stables, located in the Palmeraie or at the foot of the Atlas, offer rides suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced riders. Well-trained horses and ponies, passionate guides and breathtaking scenery for unforgettable moments.
features: Mint tea at the end of the ride

yoga-et-pilates.title: Yoga and Pilates
yoga-et-pilates.metaDescription: Yoga and Pilates classes in Marrakech. Certified instructor in your villa or outdoors. Hatha, vinyasa, yin and reformer. All levels.
yoga-et-pilates.description: Yoga and Pilates sessions in the comfort of your villa or outdoors. Our certified instructors guide you.
yoga-et-pilates.longDescription: Marrakech's sunny climate is ideal for practising yoga and Pilates outdoors. Our certified instructors travel to your villa, terrace or garden for personalised sessions. From dawn yoga to dusk Pilates, every session is a parenthesis of serenity during your stay.
features: In villa, on terrace or in garden
highlights: Ideal for regaining form and energy

aqua-karting.title: Aqua Karting
aqua-karting.metaDescription: Aqua karting in Marrakech: water karting for the whole family. Original and fun activity. Hire by 15-minute session.
aqua-karting.description: Aquatic karting, an original and fun activity for the whole family. Adrenaline and laughter guaranteed on the water.
aqua-karting.longDescription: Aqua karting is the most original activity in Marrakech. Karts on special tyres glide across the water surface for a unique and hilarious experience. Accessible from age 6 with an adult, it's the perfect activity for a fun break between visits or to keep children entertained safely.
highlights: Fun guaranteed for young and old

karting.title: Go-karting
karting.metaDescription: Go-karting circuit in Marrakech. Senior and junior karts. Timing, private races and corporate events.
karting.description: Prove your driving skills on our professional go-karting circuit. Emotions and speed for young and old.
karting.longDescription: Our go-karting circuit, designed to FIA standards, offers authentic speed sensations in a safe environment. Powerful 4-stroke karts, technical chicanes and fast straights for a demanding track. Professional timing to challenge your friends and family. The youngest have their own junior karts on a dedicated circuit.
highlights: Ideal for birthdays and stag/hen parties

paintball.title: Paintball
paintball.metaDescription: Paintball in Marrakech: outdoor field, complete equipment, bespoke scenarios. Team building, stag/hen parties and groups.
paintball.description: Challenge your friends on our paintball field in the great outdoors. Strategy, team spirit and adrenaline on the programme.
paintball.longDescription: Our paintball field, located in the great outdoors on the outskirts of Marrakech, offers varied and immersive scenarios. Fortress, jungle, Berber village... every game is a unique strategic adventure. Latest-generation equipment, natural and artificial barriers, and professional animation team for memorable games.

side-car-vintage.title: Vintage Side Car
side-car-vintage.metaDescription: Vintage sidecar ride in Marrakech. Tour of the medina, Palmeraie and Atlas. Unique and romantic duo experience.
side-car-vintage.description: Explore Marrakech by vintage sidecar. A unique and original experience to discover the red city in pairs.
side-car-vintage.longDescription: The vintage sidecar is the most original way to discover Marrakech. In pairs with a passionate pilot, you travel through the lively alleys of the medina, the shaded roads of the Palmeraie and the villages of the Atlas. A experience both nostalgic and adventurous, perfect for couples and friends seeking authenticity.
features: Tour of the medina and souks

jet-ski.title: Jet Ski
jet-ski.metaDescription: Jet ski hire in Marrakech on the Agdal lakes. Guided jet ski ride. Sessions from 15 min to 1h. All levels.
jet-ski.description: Looking for adrenaline? Set off on a jet ski on the peaceful lakes of Marrakech. An unforgettable experience at the foot of the Atlas.
jet-ski.longDescription: The Agdal lakes and Lalla Takerkoust dam offer an ideal setting for jet skiing. The calm water and mountainous Atlas landscape create a spectacular playground. Our instructors accompany you for a guided ride or free session, in complete safety.
highlights: Exceptional setting at the foot of the Atlas

sonographie.title: Sound therapy
sonographie.metaDescription: Sound therapy and sound meditation session in Marrakech. Tibetan bowls, gongs and vibratory instruments. Deep relaxation in villa.
sonographie.description: Immerse yourself in a deep relaxation experience with sound therapy. The vibrations of Tibetan bowls and gongs will soothe you.
sonographie.longDescription: Sound therapy is an ancient practice that uses sound vibrations to harmonise the body and mind. Our certified practitioners use Tibetan bowls, gongs and vibratory instruments to guide you towards a state of deep relaxation. This immersive experience, ideal as a complement to yoga or massage, provides total letting go.
features: Possibility of nighttime session under the stars

vos-soirees-festives.title: Your festive evenings
vos-soirees-festives.metaDescription: Private party organisation in Marrakech. DJ, catering, decoration, sound system. Parties in your villa or private venue.
vos-soirees-festives.description: Organise memorable parties in your villa. DJ, catering, decoration, sound system... we take care of everything.
vos-soirees-festives.longDescription: Marrakech is the perfect city to celebrate. Whether for a birthday, a stag/hen party, New Year's Eve or simply an evening with friends, our events team transforms your villa into an exceptional party venue. DJ, gourmet catering, decorator, ambient lighting... every detail is designed to create an unforgettable atmosphere.

vos-demandes-specifiques.title: Your bespoke requests
vos-demandes-specifiques.metaDescription: Bespoke service in Marrakech. Special requests, private events, exclusive experiences. Contact us for a personalised quote.
vos-demandes-specifiques.description: Have a special request? Our team is at your disposal to create a 100% bespoke experience in Marrakech.
vos-demandes-specifiques.longDescription: Every client is unique and every stay deserves a personal touch. Whether you want to organise a wedding on a terrace with Atlas views, book a private dinner in a historic riad, arrange a helicopter flight over the desert or any other creative idea, our team mobilises to turn your dream into reality.

votre-seminaire.title: Your seminar
votre-seminaire.metaDescription: Corporate seminar organisation in Marrakech. Meeting rooms, team building, gala dinner. Luxury residences and private riads.
votre-seminaire.description: Organise your corporate seminar in Marrakech. Reception spaces, equipment, team building... everything is possible.
votre-seminaire.longDescription: Marrakech has become the reference destination for corporate seminars in North Africa. The unique blend of modernity and tradition, the sunny climate and the richness of available experiences make it an ideal setting to motivate your teams. Our luxury residences and private riads offer modular reception spaces, latest-generation technical equipment and bespoke service.
features: Bespoke team building (quad, escape game, cooking)

palmeraie.title: Villa rental in the Palmeraie, Marrakech
palmeraie.subtitle: Discover our luxury villas in Marrakech's most prestigious neighbourhood. The Palmeraie offers a green and peaceful setting, ideal for family holidays or trips with friends.
palmeraie.description1: The Palmeraie in Marrakech is a sought-after residential area, located about 10 minutes by car from the city centre. This estate of several thousand hectares of date palms offers an exceptional natural setting, far from the hustle and bustle of the medina.
palmeraie.description2: The villas of the Palmeraie stand out for their large landscaped gardens, heated private pools and architecture blending Moroccan tradition with modern comfort. It is the ideal choice for families, groups of friends or travellers seeking tranquillity and prestige.
bullets: Peace and greenery in the heart of Marrakech
10 minutes from the city centre and medina
Villas with large gardens and private pools
Proximity to golf courses and equestrian centres
nearbyItems: Camel rides in the palm groves
Buggies and quads in the Agafay desert
palmeraie.villasTitle: Our available villas in the Palmeraie
palmeraie.noVilla: No villa available in the Palmeraie at the moment.

faq.q1: Is the Palmeraie far from the city centre?
faq.a1: No, the Palmeraie is only 10-15 minutes by car from the city centre and Jemaa el-Fna square. It's the best of both worlds: tranquillity and proximity.
faq.q2: Do the Palmeraie villas have pools?
faq.a2: Yes, all our Palmeraie villas have heated private pools, surrounded by landscaped gardens with palm and olive trees.
faq.q3: Can we organise excursions from the Palmeraie?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Our concierge organises camel rides, Agafay desert excursions, medina tours and much more.

gueliz.title: Villa rental in Gueliz, Marrakech
gueliz.subtitle: Gueliz, Marrakech's modern district, combines urbanity with Moroccan charm. Lively, accessible and dynamic, it is the ideal place for a stay in Marrakech.
gueliz.description1: Gueliz is the modern district of Marrakech, created during the French protectorate. It is today the beating heart of the city's urban life, with its design boutiques, art galleries and burgeoning culinary scene.
gueliz.description2: The villas of Gueliz offer direct access to shops, restaurants and cultural venues, while benefiting from the calm of private residences. Ideal for travellers who want to enjoy the city without having to travel.
bullets: Shops, restaurants and galleries on foot
gueliz.noVilla: No villa available in Gueliz at the moment.

faq.a1: Yes, Gueliz is one of Marrakech's safest neighbourhoods, very popular with tourists and expats. The streets are well-lit and lively until late at night.
faq.q2: Can you get around on foot from Gueliz?
faq.a2: Yes, Gueliz is one of the rare neighbourhoods in Marrakech where walking is pleasant. Shops, cafés and restaurants are accessible on foot, and the Majorelle Garden is just a few minutes away.
faq.a3: No, our villas are located in quiet private residences, while being immediately close to the district's entertainment. You get the best of both worlds.

targa.title: Villa rental in Targa, Marrakech
targa.subtitle: Targa is a quiet residential neighbourhood in Marrakech, popular for its family villas, green spaces and proximity to the city centre.
targa.description1: Targa is a rapidly expanding residential neighbourhood, located between Gueliz and the ocean of sand. This district combines the calm of family residences with proximity to shops and international schools.
targa.description2: The villas of Targa are modern, spacious and surrounded by landscaped gardens. The neighbourhood is particularly popular with families with children and expats seeking tranquillity and safety.
targa.noVilla: No villa available in Targa at the moment.

faq.a1: Yes, Targa is one of Marrakech's most family-friendly neighbourhoods. The streets are quiet, the villas spacious and international schools are nearby.
faq.q2: Can you get around easily from Targa?
faq.a2: Yes, Targa is well connected to the city centre (10-15 min by car) and to the Route de l'Ourika. Our concierge can arrange transfers.
faq.a3: Yes, most of Targa's villas are recent or renovated, with modern amenities (fitted kitchen, air conditioning, private pool).

amelkis.title: Villa rental in Amelkis, Marrakech
amelkis.subtitle: Amelkis is a sought-after residential neighbourhood in Marrakech, known for its golf estate and prestige villas. An exceptional setting for luxury holidays.
amelkis.description1: Amelkis is one of Marrakech's most prestigious neighbourhoods. This 400-hectare residential estate surrounds the Royal Golf d'Amelkis, one of the most beautiful courses in Morocco. The villas are nestled in a green setting, among olive and palm trees.
amelkis.description2: The neighbourhood attracts a discerning international clientele seeking calm, safety and prestige. The properties are spacious, with landscaped gardens and private pools, ideal for families and golf enthusiasts.
nearbyItems: Royal Golf Amelkis — 27 holes, national ranking
amelkis.noVilla: No villa available in Amelkis at the moment.

faq.q1: Do you need to be a golfer to live in Amelkis?
faq.a1: No, golf is an asset but not a requirement. Amelkis is first and foremost a calm and secure residential neighbourhood, popular with families and travellers seeking tranquillity.
faq.a2: Yes, Amelkis is 15 minutes from the city centre, close to shops and well connected. Our concierge can arrange transfers and vehicles.
faq.a3: Yes, the villas of Amelkis are among the most spacious in Marrakech, often with 4 to 6 bedrooms, gardens of 1000m² or more, and private pools.

routeOurika.title: Villa rental on the Route de l'Ourika
routeOurika.subtitle: The Route de l'Ourika is one of the most scenic roads in Morocco. Atlas panoramas, Berber villages and unspoilt nature 20 minutes from Marrakech.
routeOurika.whyChoose: Why choose the Route de l'Ourika?
routeOurika.description1: The Route de l'Ourika stretches 30 kilometres from Marrakech to the heart of the High Atlas. It is a popular destination for its magnificent landscapes, waterfalls and traditional Berber villages.
routeOurika.description2: The villas in this area offer spectacular views of the Atlas mountains, absolute tranquillity and a direct connection with nature. It is the ideal choice for travellers seeking authenticity and serenity.

faq.q1: Do you need a car to get around?
faq.a1: Yes, a car is recommended to fully enjoy the area. Our concierge can arrange a vehicle with driver or a rental.
faq.q2: Do the villas have Atlas views?
faq.a2: Yes, most of our villas on the Route de l'Ourika offer spectacular views of the High Atlas mountains, sometimes with unforgettable sunsets.
faq.q3: Can you go hiking from the villa?
faq.a3: Absolutely. The Route de l'Ourika is the starting point for numerous hikes, from gentle walks to more ambitious treks in the High Atlas.

fallbackContent: Commercial Director for many years at Filovent, Europe's leader in boat rental with over 17,000 references across 57 countries, Cyrille decided to create in 2014 a agency specialising in seasonal rental of charming and character properties in Marrakech.

Today, StaysInMarrakech's area of expertise has expanded from seasonal rentals to long-term rentals and more recently to sales, always with the same concern for offering quality properties and rigorous support services, in defining client needs as well as in daily management.

Composed of a young and dynamic team of specialists in each area of expertise, StaysInMarrakech offers an optimum and reactive service, always with the concern of being exemplary in know-how as well as in people skills. Passion, good humour and excellence are our daily values.
StaysInMarrakech is a company specialising in luxury and prestige villa rentals in Marrakech.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our luxury villa rentals in Marrakech
faqs.q1: What is the average price of a luxury villa in Marrakech?
faqs.a1: Our luxury villas in Marrakech are available from 350€ per night. Prices vary depending on size, location, and amenities.
faqs.q2: What is the best time to rent a villa in Marrakech?
faqs.a2: Marrakech is a year-round destination. Peak season is March-May and September-November with ideal weather.
faqs.q3: Do the villas include a concierge service?
faqs.a3: Yes, all our villas benefit from our dedicated concierge service to make your stay exceptional.
faqs.q4: Which neighborhoods in Marrakech are the villas located in?
faqs.a4: Our villas are located in the most sought-after neighborhoods: Palmeraie, Gueliz, Route de l'Ourika, Amelkis, and Targa.
faqs.q5: Do I need a visa to rent a villa in Morocco?
faqs.a5: EU citizens do not need a visa for stays up to 90 days. A valid passport is sufficient.
faqs.q6: What is the difference between short-term and long-term rental?
faqs.a6: Short-term rental (1-30 nights) is ideal for vacations. Long-term rental (1-12 months) suits expats and professionals.
faqs.q7: Do you offer airport transfers from Marrakech?
faqs.a7: Yes, we organize private transfers from Marrakech Menara Airport to your villa.
faqs.q8: Are the villas suitable for families with children?
faqs.a8: Absolutely. Most of our villas have children's rooms, pools, and gardens suitable for families.
